```yaml
name: Link Check and Directory Overview

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Install lychee
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y lychee
      
    - name: Run link check
      run: |
        lychee --config lychee.toml .
        
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest -q
        
  directory-overview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [link-check, test]
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Generate directory overview
      run: |
        mkdir -p docs
        find . -type f -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./__pycache__/*" -not -path "./.github/*" | sort > docs/directory-overview.txt
        
    - name: Update README with directory overview
      run: |
        echo "# Directory Overview" > temp-readme.md
        echo "" >> temp-readme.md
        echo "## Files in Repository" >> temp-readme.md
        echo "" >> temp-readme.md
        cat docs/directory-overview.txt | sed 's/^/- /' >> temp-readme.md
        echo "" >> temp-readme.md
        echo "## Repository Structure" >> temp-readme.md
        echo "" >> temp-readme.md
        find . -type d -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./__pycache__/*" -not -path "./.github/*" | sort | sed 's/^/  - /' >> temp-readme.md
        echo "" >> temp-readme.md
        echo "## File Types" >> temp-readme.md
        echo "" >> temp-readme.md
        find . -type f -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./__pycache__/*" -not -path "./.github/*" | sed 's/.*\.//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | sed 's/^/  - /' >> temp-readme.md
        cat README.md >> temp-readme.md
        mv temp-readme.md README.md
```
